rv.q: This performance is exciting, inventive, and inspiring.
If it doesn’t all align or ignite as it might, Rice’s vision carries her irresistible brand of charm and whimsy.

Her version of Malory Towers is full of what we have come to expect from an Emma Rice show – live music, anachronistic references, joyful set pieces and rammed home messages of collective responsibility.

cn.t: Emma Rice's vibrant adaptation of Enid Blyton's boarding school series delights with strong performances, joyful musicality, and her signature theatrical flair, delivering a wholesome and gloriously silly celebration of friendship and female empowerment.
